review_scope: dashboard query units and environment isolation

findings.finding: Cross-environment aggregation could mask a failed environment.
findings.resolution: Contract requires one environment per rule evaluator; dashboard requires one explicit non-All environment and every surface query filters it.

findings.finding: A live heartbeat alone could falsely imply usable SLO evidence while an observation or histogram series is absent.
findings.resolution: Each surface enumerates required_series; missing rules use absent() for every required metric plus a >300-second heartbeat timestamp test, and activation requires bounded-series preinitialization.

findings.finding: Mixed ratio and latency targets could render misleading dashboard units.
findings.resolution: Public latency and withdrawal short-window targets have explicit field unit overrides; stable refIds are validator-covered.

findings.finding: Preinitialized but idle observation counters produced a zero denominator; clamp_min converted that state into a 100% failure ratio and paged every burn rule.
findings.resolution: Every fast/slow window now requires an explicit total-denominator > 0 guard; clamp_min is removed, zero traffic is NO DATA, and release interpretation remains HOLD without a burn page.

findings.finding: A single present observation series could satisfy absent(metric) while the remaining bounded budget/outcome series were missing, allowing partial telemetry to appear usable.
findings.resolution: The contract fixes per-surface series counts and each telemetry alert compares total plus allowed label-lattice counts; missing, duplicate, unexpected or excess series page and HOLD.

findings.finding: The latency bucket set and dead-letter event_type values were described as bounded but not enumerated, so the configuration had no measurable cardinality ceiling.
findings.resolution: Nine latency buckets and four current-main dead-letter event types are fixed. The canonical ceiling is exactly 72 series per environment and any growth requires contract review.

findings.finding: The dashboard coverage panel counted only seven healthy heartbeats and could render green while observation, histogram or dead-letter series were incomplete.
findings.resolution: Five exact 1/0 coverage targets now verify 7 heartbeats, 42 observation series, 9 buckets, 2 histogram companions and 12 dead-letter series for one environment.

optimization_readback: Seven findings resolved. Zero traffic is NO DATA without burn paging; incomplete or over-cardinality telemetry pages and HOLDs; one provider-neutral contract, dashboard, rule file and runbook remain. No SLO target, producer, provider or activation state changed.
